rows.text: for `i` = 0 to 2 calls `00263FF0(i)` and, when bit 0 of byte `+0x10` of the result is set, walks indices from word `+0x1DE` up to (word `+0x1DE` + word `+0x1D6`) exclusive, calling `00358940(result, index)`; for each non-null return whose qword `+0xC0` is non-null and whose dword there is not -1 and low word not 0xFFFF, takes the `0x740`-byte record at qword `022C6F28` + that signed word `* 0x740` and, when it is non-null and its dword `+0x284` is non-zero, calls `00428FE0(record, 0)`

returns without work when `rcx` is null, its qword `+0xC0` is null, the dword there is -1 or its low word is 0xFFFF, or when the `0x740`-byte record at qword `022C6F28` + that signed word `* 0x740` is null, has dword `+0x284` zero or gives a null `record + 0x550`; otherwise tail-jumps to `003AF320(record + 0x550, edx == 0)`

calls `002640C0` (incoming `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8` unchanged), then `00267E10(r9)`, and with `v` = that result calls `0025AE00(first result, k, v)` for `k` = 0, 1, 4, 2 and finally 3, the last as a tail jump
with `p` = qword `+0x48` of `rcx`, returns 0 when `edx` is not below dword `p+0` (unsigned), else returns dword `p + 8 + edx * 8` (`edx` sign-extended)

when dword `02EBCAA0` is greater than 0 (signed), calls `0026B500(qword, 1)` for each qword of the 8-byte-stride array at `02EBCA80`, while the index stays below dword `02EBCAA0` (re-read each pass, signed); otherwise does nothing
stores 0 at dword `+0x23C` of `rcx` when dword `+0xC4` is -1 or bit 14 (0x4000) of dword `+0x304` is set; otherwise stores `xmm1` there (`movss`)
